{{Quote|Through alchemy, one uses the Force to effect change on the physical.|[[Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="TBoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Force alchemy''',<ref name="Into the Void" /> better known as '''Sith alchemy''', was a science that referred to a number of areas under the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. It encompassed any power or technique which used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to permanently alter an item or living being. It is rejected by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as an act of treason against the [[Force-bond/Legends|Force's]] will.

==History==
===Je'daii Order of Tython===
[[File:SWDotJ_2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Shae Koda]] astride her alchemically manipulated [[rancor-dragon]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].]]
{{Quote|Alchemy should have no part in a Je'daii's experience. It is a dark force, arcane and dangerous. It has the power to upset balance. There are other ways.|[[Je'daii Temple Master]] [[Vor'Dana]], 26,032 BBY|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
A power related to elemental manipulation and metallurgy, Force alchemy was an ability practiced by some members of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Taught at the Temple of Science, [[Anil Kesh]], practice of alchemy required leaning into the dark side of the Force, but was deemed a permissible skill for study by the [[Je'daii Council]]. Despite this, some Je'daii questioned its practice and found it to be perverse or heretical. [[Je'daii Master]] [[Dam-Powl]] viewed her student [[Lanoree Brock]]'s talent to genetically manipulate cells from her own body and create life, a skill called the [[alchemy of flesh]]. This skill could be used on any bit of flesh and used to manipulate other flesh, such as when Ranger Brock used skin particles to sear the memory of another person, erasing their memories by pushing the skin dust up into his brain.<ref name="Into the Void" />

At Anil Kesh, the Je'daii carried out alchemical experiments on wild beasts captured in the [[Abyss of Ruh]], a pit deep in the heart of the [[Rift]]lands. The genetical manipulation of these animals was not done in a way that hurt or damaged the beasts, but the Je'daii believed that it was the true wish of their natural evolution that was being forwarded. Aside from alteration to living flesh, the Je'daii also used alchemical metallurgy to alter weapons both traditional and Force-based tools. Transmutation of chemicals and the restricting of solids were related abilities.<ref name="Into the Void" />

===Sith Order===
{{Quote|But ask me the secrets of Sith alchemy, and I would ask you for three measures of blood: one from a person you love, one from a person you hate, and one from yourself.|[[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]|<ref name="EGF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
While the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] practiced Sith alchemy long before the [[Exiles]] arrived on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], it was the Exiles who perfected it, one of their best being [[Sorzus Syn]], using the knowledge to create the [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] that they used during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]].<ref name="TBoS" /> Sith alchemy made it possible for<ref name="evil">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> the Exiles to interbreed with the Sith species.<ref name="GoldenAge2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

[[File:Sith_monsters.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Monsters created by Sith alchemy: a [[Sith war behemoth]], a [[Sith war worm]], and a [[chrysalide]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]]]

Sith alchemy was primarily used to enhance the strength of weapons and armor (such as the famous [[Sith sword]]s), or to genetically engineer and enhance alien species, making them more dangerous and easier to control by the Sith Lords. More sinisterly, Sith alchemy was capable of waking the dead in servitude to the Sith.<ref name="TBoS" /> [[Korriban zombie]]s,<ref name="Planet of Lost Souls">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|int=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref> and possibly [[Sith undead]],<ref name="mysteries">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> were creations of this branch of the art. They are also known, in the [[Sith (language)|Sith language]], as the [[Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut]] - the reanimated dead.<ref name="TBoS" />

One of the many applications of Sith Alchemy was the art of creating nefarious toxins, such as [[Sith poison]].<ref name="DSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="GoldenAge4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] wrote many texts concerning the art of Sith alchemy.<ref name="EGF" /> These were studied by [[Seviss Vaa]], whose experiments were responsible for the [[Behemoth from the World Below]].<ref name="Aduba">{{GamerCite|4|The Starhoppers of Aduba-3}}</ref> Certain xenobiologists suspected that the predators of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]] and the native [[Melodie]]s may have been products of Sith alchemy.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

While he was on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Naga Sadow used Sith alchemy to mutate his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors and create a [[Sith wyrm]].<ref name="DarkLords4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> Sadow's successor as Dark Lord of the Sith,<ref name="DarkLords6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], used Sith alchemy to create terrifying creatures twisted by the dark side's influence such as [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydras]] and [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Around this time, the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerer of Tund]] [[Karnak Tetsu]] practiced Sith alchemy.<ref name="Karnak Tetsu, Sorcerer of Tund">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORweben5|text=KOTOR Campaign Guide Web Enhancement 5: Karnak Tetsu, Sorcerer of Tund}}</ref>

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] wrote a book about Sith alchemy entitled ''[[The Creation of Monsters]]'',<ref name="EGF" /> and was responsible for the creation of such monstrosities as [[Shadow Droid]]s<ref name="DEII 1">[[Dark Empire II 1|''Dark Empire II'' 1]]</ref> and [[Chrysalide|chrysalis beasts]].<ref name="DEII 5">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> He claimed that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was partially an alchemical creation.<ref name="EGF" /> Palpatine may have also utilized the [[Mask (Sith Alchemy)|mask]] ability to hide his true, corrupted features.<ref name="Jedi Counseling 71">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050804jc71|series=Jedi Counseling|text=71}}</ref>

The [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophet of the Dark Side]] [[Cronal|Blackhole]] was referred to as Palpatine's "monster-maker", and was responsible for the creation of such [[Sithspawn/Legends|sithspawn]] as [[Gorc]] and [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]] through the dark art of Sith Alchemy.<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> Blackhole also created a specialized helmet that, when used, would amplify his dark side powers to an astounding degree, as well as allowing him to draw on the force abilities of other force-sensitives called the [[Pawn]]s.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]] taught the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] how to utilize Sith alchemy. Rystra used his knowledge of the subject to carry out investigations inside the [[Room of Change]] in the [[Temple of Pain]], and he experimented on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] [[Blaschowwa]], [[Kamtis Bonai]], [[Vobin Sobos]] and [[Desvin Tor'thal]].<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref>

The [[One Sith]] featured Sith Alchemy heavily in their plans. [[Darth Maladi]] used Sith Alchemy in combination with [[Shaping protocol|Vong Shaping]] to create the [[Vongspawn virus]] and set off the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. In the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] [[Vul Isen]] used Sith Alchemy, aided by knowledge provided by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], to create an [[Sea Leviathan|aquatic form of Leviathan]] to hunt down the people of [[Genocide on Dac|Dac]].

Many creatures altered by Sith alchemy were able to see in complete darkness, although they could not distinguish [[Color/Legends|colors]].
